thread:
Sam Patel: Delta POC blocked — dedicated GPU pool reservation failing with ALLOC_CONFLICT. Need swarming help, customer demo Wed. region=us-central1, requested 4xA100, reservation_id=reserv-9f3. Also seeing 429s on reservation API. @Priya can you triage? /cc @Mei
Priya Nair: Looking. can you paste the error logs? did provisioning ever hit any quotas?
Sam Patel: Pasting portal snippet and infra logs below. Billing also asking about committed price vs on-demand when fallback occurs. customer worried about overage costs.
infra-bot: [system] provisioning task 0x7a9 failed: ALLOC_CONFLICT (AZ-affinity mismatch). region=us-central1, requested_azs=[us-central1-a,us-central1-b], available_pools=[us-central1-c,us-central1-d]. retrying (2/3)
Mei Chen: ALLOC_CONFLICT usually means reserved affinity couldn't find matching hosts. Did the customer set az_affinity? what's the reservation config?
Sam Patel: Their reservation yaml:
```yaml
reservation_id: reserv-9f3
region: us-central1
az_affinity: ["us-central1-a","us-central1-b"]
gpus: 4
instance_type: a100-80gb
fallback_policy: "auto-fallback"
```
Priya Nair: Ah — auto-fallback + strict az_affinity is contradictory. If provider only has capacity in c/d, allocator fails. Options: remove az_affinity or allow cross-AZ fallback for the POC. @Mei can ops relax AZ constraint temporarily?
Mei Chen: We can flip az_affinity_opt_out for a single reservation. Running adhoc command now:
`/infra reserve update --id reserv-9f3 --az-affinity-opt-out true`
Expect allocation unless provider-side quotas block it.
Sam Patel: Also seeing 429s when hitting /reservations/claim — spikes when our agent retries quickly. Are we doing exponential backoff?
Priya Nair: Client does 2 retries with fixed 1s delay today; we should change to exp backoff + jitter. Short-term: throttle demo runner to avoid bursts.
Jorge Alvarez: Delta also asked about pricing: if we relax AZ affinity and it lands in a different AZ, does reserved pricing still apply? They worry about surprise charges.
BillingBot: Reserved pricing applies at region-level for an active reservation_id. Cross-AZ placement within same region does NOT change reserved commit price. Overage billing only applies if usage > reserved vGPU-hours.
Mei Chen: Update: the reservation flag change applied. infra-bot status:
infra-bot: [system] allocate task 0x7a9 retry 3/3 succeeded -> pool_id=pool-992, hosts in us-central1-c. provisioning step complete.
Sam Patel: Confirmed allocation succeeded and customer can run validation. Demo back on track — thanks all.
Priya Nair: Follow-ups: update POC quickstart doc to recommend avoiding strict az_affinity for initial POCs, and bump client retry policy to exp backoff + jitter. Also add a note about rate-limiting the reservation API from CI.
Sam Patel: Thanks team. I'll loop in Legal for the security questionnaire that popped up and follow up on pricing clarification. Closing after demo success. :tada:
